links.outcome: Sensitivity change from balanced refinement dataset to real-world-prevalence validation dataset
links.effect: Sensitivity decreased from 0.91 to 0.62 between datasets; F1 for expert-driven workflow 0.81 in validation vs 0.87 in refinement, agentic 0.74 vs 0.93, attributed to prevalence shift.
links.quote: Sensitivity decreased from 0.91 to 0.62 between datasets, demonstrating the impact of prevalence shift on generalizability.

links.outcome: Share of apparent false negatives that were actually correct on expert re-adjudication
links.effect: Expert re-adjudication found 44% of apparent false negatives reflected clinically appropriate reasoning, indicating the original reference labels understated model accuracy.
links.quote: Expert re-adjudication revealed 44% of apparent false negatives reflected clinically appropriate reasoning.
